gaps.explanation: Proprietary funds statement p6 (printed p8) Total operating expenses 802,967 includes Depreciation 48,358 (Light 27,530 + Water 11,888 + Other Enterprise 8,940), a non-cash item. The budgetary comparison schedules (pp18-22, budgetary basis actuals) print no depreciation: Light 643,175 (= 670,705 - 27,530), Water 31,998 (= 43,886 - 11,888), Sewer 42,816 + Landfill 35,424 + Meter Deposit 1,196 = 79,436 (= 88,376 - 8,940). Schedule total 754,609 + depreciation 48,358 = 802,967. Gap is exactly the depreciation the schedules do not report; no detail fix.
